question: Please help me find the names of top 5 players with the highest average runs per match in season 5, along with their batting averages.
sql:
-- Final query: top 5 players by average runs per match in season 5, with their batting averages
WITH season5_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker AS player_id,
           bbb.match_id,
           SUM(bbs.runs_scored) AS runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bbs ON bbb.match_id = bbs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bbs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bbs.ball_id
    WHERE bbb.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbb.match_id
),
player_totals AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           SUM(runs) AS total_runs,
           COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches_played
    FROM player_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id,
           COUNT(*) AS dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN match m ON wt.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY player_out
)
SELECT p.player_name,
       ROUND(1.0 * pt.total_runs / pt.matches_played, 2) AS avg_runs_per_match,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(pd.dismissals, 0) > 0 
            THEN ROUND(1.0 * pt.total_runs / pd.dismissals, 2) 
            ELSE NULL 
       END AS batting_average
FROM player_totals pt
JOIN player p ON pt.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pd ON pt.player_id = pd.player_id
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH season5_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker AS player_id,
           bbb.match_id,
           SUM(bbs.runs_scored) AS runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb

    WHERE bbb.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbb.match_id
),
player_totals AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           SUM(runs) AS total_runs,
           COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches_played
    FROM player_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id,
           COUNT(*) AS dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN match m ON wt.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY player_out
)
SELECT p.player_name,
       ROUND(1.0 * pt.total_runs / pt.matches_played, 2) AS avg_runs_per_match,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(pd.dismissals, 0) > 0 
            THEN ROUND(1.0 * pt.total_runs / pd.dismissals, 2) 
            ELSE NULL
